title: Have you tried 120B models unquantized? If not try here...
author: Growth4Good
selftext:
You can check out our AI game we've been working on and tell me what you think. We are working on an API too. 

https://preview.redd.it/4hgwj7pydekc1.png?width=958&format=png&auto=webp&s=8f01712e660c14c3c7f8a20b0d01f8e3d0265063

https://preview.redd.it/9l6fp6pydekc1.png?width=599&format=png&auto=webp&s=d60b9f9d579e6e5f29e0956123275fee4b30d8bf

comments.author: surpurdurd
comments.body: You really should allow people to try it out before asking for login info. That, or you gotta really beef up the sales pitch.

replies.author: LookingForTroubleQ
replies.body: we get tons of signups regardless but I agree google signup is becoming an issue

replies.author: Growth4Good
replies.body: Try it out before signing in? I mean we want to verify user so we can count gpu seconds, it's not free to run GPU servers. We're burning money to give free credits, but we need those free credits to be counted. This is not some 13b model, these models take real powerful hardware.

replies.author: surpurdurd
replies.body: Is there no way to track the info you need with cookies? I'm not an expert, I'm sure you did your best. All I'm saying is you haven't convinced me to give you any of my personal info

replies.author: Pekelni_Bororshna_69
replies.body: Firefox Focus = zero cookies, infinite play time!

replies.author: LookingForTroubleQ
replies.body: yeah we hosted free servers with cookies for about 2 months but time to move on now - 120b models are expensive and we are only seeking paying users at this point now anyway
